prompt: Revise this original Kagami concept sprite sheet. Keep her violet high ponytail, silver ribbons, ivory shrine jacket with lavender trim, navy split hakama trousers, hand mirror, adult face and outfit identity. The previous art became blurry at game size. Create extremely crisp, chunky low-resolution pixel art with a dark ink contour, high contrast broad ivory coat panels, saturated violet hair, dark navy legs, lavender accents, a clear octagonal mirror with dark rim. NO antialiasing, no gradients, no soft shading, no tiny texture, no pale haze. Each individual character should read as a 44-pixel-high game sprite enlarged by nearest-neighbor for this sheet. Use a tightly controlled palette and 1-2 shades per material. Four columns by two rows, eight entirely separated whole-body views: idle right, walking right first step, walking right opposite step, attacking/plucking mirror right, healing mirror raised, teleport mirror forward, hit reaction, kneeling death. Consistent body height, proportions and lighting across all eight. Connected anatomy throughout. Every pose must include whole legs and feet. Lean readable priestess silhouette with bold sleeve shapes, slightly wider than the previous source, at stock hero scale. No lettering, no terrain, no background, transparent background. Do not change her into a mermaid or generic stock priest. The reference defines appearance, but redraw it crisply with fewer large pixel blocks.
